change: Transfer a detached ready-observation bucket through a read-only view instead of copying it with toList().

performance_assessment.reason: The benchmark-only ready-transfer control supplied five in-run pairs for each dictionary mode. Both median deltas favor read-only transfer, but both exact bootstrap intervals include zero, so this result does not establish a measurable speedup.
performance_assessment.required_next_evidence: Profile a larger ring-drain or collector-join reduction with the same complete paired control before making another performance acceptance claim.
